story.text: The {PHANTOM} slowly, gravely, silently {APPROACHES}. It is shrouded in a deep black garment, and never speaks; it only points. Scrooge {FEARS} it more than any spirit he has seen. In the City, it shows him {MERCHANTS} talking of a man who has {DIED}. “It’s likely to be a very {CHEAP} funeral.” Who can the dead man be?
story.caption: The Last of the Spirits
